parameters.query: SELECT c.id as conversation_id, c.tenant_id, c.platform, c.contact_id, c.last_message_at, COUNT(m.id) as message_count, STRING_AGG(CONCAT(m.role, ': ', m.content), '\n' ORDER BY m.created_at) as conversation_text FROM conversations c JOIN messages m ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.last_message_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND c.summary_embedding IS NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.tenant_id, c.platform, c.contact_id, c.last_message_at HAVING COUNT(m.id) >= 3 ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC LIMIT 10

values.content: You are a conversation summarizer. Create a concise summary of the conversation that captures: 1) Main topics discussed, 2) Key questions or concerns raised, 3) Actions taken or promised, 4) Overall sentiment, 5) Any follow-up needed. Keep it under 200 words.
